notes.title: Online Multiplayer!
notes.content:
Online multiplayer has been added to DYB! If you have any issues, please email me the problem(s) at: riseoftheclackn@yahoo.com. 

Update Log:

Update 1.11

notes.title: Small Fixes and changes
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! This is a small update that fixes an issue where the price for zombie house upgrades don't reset upon a new game. also, the minimum spawn rate for MGD's has been increased slightly, so as not to overwhelm the player. And a few other things.

Anyways, thanks for playing! And let me know of any bug's glitches, etc... at riseoftheclackn@yahoo.com.

Update log:
Update 1.10.10 8/18/22
	-Added shot count to the shotgun's
	-Zombie house upgrade cost now properly resets, upon starting a new game
	-Increased shooting range of weapons, so that you can now shoot far away zombies in zombie house mode
	-Increased zombie walking speed slightly
	-Increased minimum spawn rate for machine gun dudes, so that they are not as overwhelming

notes.title: New Graphic's Settings
notes.content:
This small update adds some graphics settings, as well as fixing the resolution options, so that they actually work. Thanks for playing! 

As always, let me now of any bug's/glitches/etc...
riseoftheclackn@yahoo.com

Update 1.10.09 7/2/22
	-Fixed the options menu, so that the various resolution options actually work
	-Added graphics settings to the options menu
	-The main menu, and the pause menu both use the same options menu ui

notes.title: Small Updates, and a Temp Fix
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This update puts in a "Kill Switch", that you can use to advance to the next round, if there are missing enemies. Just be careful and don't spam it, because it can mess up the kill count.

There are also a few small fixes. Like the MGD only ever doing base damage to the player. Which is really handy for the later rounds.

And as always, let me know of any bugs, glitches, etc...
riseoftheclackn@yahoo.com

Update log:

Update 1.10.08 6/25/22
-Wall Turrets and Rifleman now show their own exp/lvls, instead of the players equipped weapon's exp/lvl
	-Machine Gun Dude's now only ever do base damage to the player
	-Added a "Kill Switch" to classic/Tower Defense/Zombie House lvl's, for when there are missing enemies stopping you from advancing to the next round
	-Fixed issue where enemy weapons would not disappear sometimes, after their death
	-Wall Turrets and Rifleman now have max fire rates

notes.title: A Small Update. Less Enemy Damage
notes.content:
Hello All! I know it's been over a year, since the last update. I'm sorry! :( But life is life. But anyways, Here is a small update, which reduces the enemy damage scaling. Also, it adds a clip size cap to the weapons. So they they do not get too ridiculous, as your weapons level up. And as always, thank you for playing! :)

Let me know of any bugs/glitches, etc...
riseoftheclackn@yahoo.com

Here is the update log:
Update 1.10.05 12/13/21
	-When selecting your character in single player, the character voice now speaks when clicking on the character image, not after hitting play
	-Reduced the number of spawn zones in bunker mode lvls, to reduce instant spawning issues
	-Changed enemy damage scaling to adding .2 damage per enemy level, instead of adding a multiple of 0.02
	-Added a maximum size for magazines, per gun. Instead of limitless

notes.title: Quick Fix

Just a quick fix, making it so that the MGD's cannot damage and kill you after they die.

Update Log:

notes.title: A Few Fixes
notes.content:
Just a few fixes. Like how the MGD's actually do damage again. Oops. And the enemy characters now have varied walking speeds, as well as having a slightly slower spawn rate build-up. And the Defender wall repairmen (Classic Mode) now repair two points of damage every three seconds, instead of one point.

And as always, any bugs, glitches, etc... please email me at riseoftheclackn@yahoo.com .

Update Log:

Update 1.10.02 8/7/20
	-Wall turrets and rifleman now use the same lvling system as the player weapons
	-Fixed Rifleman Exp and leveling, so that it actually displays and saves correctly
	-Fixed issue with wall not upgrading after being clicked on while broken

notes.title: Update 1.9.5
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Update 1.9.5 is up. The update is a few fix's to the splitscreen system. The "You Died" screen should work as expected now. It didn't work at all before, for splitscreen mode. And the death splash image has been scaled to fit into the different screens better.

And the "Tomb Raids" levels now have better lighting in the player area.

Also, the Machete now unlocks at player level 3.

And please let me know of any bugs, concerns, things you want to see, etc... at riseoftheclackn@yahoo.com

Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.9.3, Better Materials

Also, the Uzi, Shotgun, and Machete all now unlock at player lvl. 5. And all other weapon unlock lvl's have been reduced by 10, to match.

And as always, please let me know of any bugs, glitches, ideas and the such, at riseoftheclackn@yahoo.com.

Thank you!

	-Fixed blood splatter decal, so that it no longer has an emissive color
	-Lowered the cost of all tower defense turrets

	-Fixed issue with tower defense mode spawning old format enemys
	-Shotgun, Uzi, and Machete are all now unlocked at lvl. 5

	-Fixed issue with player not getting coins at the end of the round, in Tower Defense mode

	-Fixed Tower Defense lvling issue

notes.title: Fixes, and new enemy levels!
notes.content:
Sorry for the three months of no update. But here it is! I fixed some things that very much needed to be fixed. Such as some buttons not working correctly with controller and/or splitscreen players. Stickman stopping short of the wall and attacking nothing, and the wall turret now actually has texture! Oops.

The enemys now have levels. Their health, damage dealt, and exp gained now all increase with enemy lvl. Also, all health bars (Except the players) now have numbers on them. The gun ui is now a part of the main hud system, instead of floating above the gun. 

All changes are in the update log, in the games file directory.

And as always, if you have any bug/glitch reports, or any ideas or such, please email me at sobeitstudios@yahoo.com

Thank you!

I have some things planned for the future. More maps, more modes, more optimization. But if you have any ideas, please let me know! :)

notes.title: Much needed fixes, and player stats
notes.content:
This update fixes the save system in the game. Instead of multiple parts of the game saving seperately, at seperate times, all saving is done by a single blueprint now. In one go. Much more effiecent and less game breaking. The game also saves upon death, and upon quiting a game.

Player stats have also been added to the game. So you can now keep track of all of the stickman that you have killed. And a bestiary has also been added, with enemy character bios. 

The bunker down levels also have been fixed, so that if you are playing splitscreen, a floating menu for the splitscreen players now pops up, so every player now has access to the weapon shop. Yay! :)

All changes are in the update log, in the file directory, as always.

Any bug reports, ideas, concerns, etc... Please email me at sobeitstudios@yahoo.com. Thank you!

notes.title: More Levels!
notes.content:
Three levels have been added to the game! Two classic defense levels, and one Bunker down level. "Forest" and, "Tomb Raids"  for the classic mode. And "Forest Bunker" for Bunker down mode. 

Save game problems have also been fixed. If starting with a new fresh save, enemies would not appear for your first game. That is fixed now. You now also have the ability to clear your save game, through the main menu options menu.

The games file directory is no longer using the "Pak" file format. It is just standard files and folders now. So it is open to modding now, if you wish.

As always, check the update log for more info.

Bugs, glitches and the such: sobeitstudios@yahoo.com

notes.title: Small Updates
notes.content:
As the title suggests, just a few small updates. The game now saves your resolution settings, as well as having the ability to set a custom resolution. There is also a "Max Spawn" setting, so you can set the max number of spawned enemys that will spawn at any given point. I recommend immediately setting this to whatever you think that your computer can handle. 

Any bug reports, questions, etc... please email me at sobeitstudios@yahoo.com. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Lots' o Fixes
notes.content:
I fixed a bunch of bugs, did some light re-programming, and changed some graphical assets to be more pleasing to look at. An update log is in the file directory, with all of the changes.

You should no longer have to deal with missing/broken guns. I did a lot of programming work on that. Also, you can no longer have the same weapon as both primary, and secondery weapons. Sorry to the ones who liked that. :)

I was planning on having a new game mode in with this update, but it didn't happen. Sorry about that.

If you have any bug reports, tips, concerns, etc... Please send them to this email address: sobeitstudios@yahoo.com. I want to make this game the best that I can! Thank you!
